subject: design/routing-evidence-v1
statement: For each intended route the caller exact-reads the demand origin and effective policy, resolves through the already-selected harness/role, appends exactly one resolution terminal, and exact-reads its proof. Only a verified `routing_resolved` proof permits claim (implementation) or model launch (review). A `routing_resolution_failed` proof permits neither.
